parameters.query:
SELECT
  snapshot_type, protocol, version, encoding, compression, payload_b64, payload_sha256, payload_size_bytes,
  to_char(created_at_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS created_at_utc,
  created_by, source_repo, source_ref
FROM governance.hub_snapshots
WHERE snapshot_type = '{{$json.snapshot_type_sql}}'
  AND is_active = true
ORDER BY created_at_utc DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ ($json.payload_b64 && $json.payload_sha256 && $json.payload_size_bytes !== null) ? { status: 'ok', snapshot_type: $json.snapshot_type, protocol: $json.protocol, version: $json.version, encoding: $json.encoding, compression: $json.compression, payload_b64: $json.payload_b64, payload_sha256: $json.payload_sha256, payload_size_bytes: Number($json.payload_size_bytes), created_at_utc: $json.created_at_utc, created_by: $json.created_by, source_repo: $json.source_repo, source_ref: $json.source_ref } : { status: 'not_found', error_code: 'SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND_OR_INVALID', message: 'no active snapshot with canonical UBIN payload for requested type' } }}
={{ { status: 'not_found', error_code: 'SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND_OR_INVALID', message: 'no active snapshot with canonical UBIN payload for requested type' } }}
